hazard: Fragmented relationship between mental health and physical health services

reports.title: Kirsty Taylor: Prevention of future deaths report

promises.quote: The creation of this new provider is progressing at pace (Project Fusion) with the new legal entity due to be in place by 1 April 2024.
promises.summary: Establish a single community and mental health provider by 1 April 2024 to integrate services and reduce fragmentation.

concerns.quote: there is and remains a fragmented relationship between mental health and physical health services, with little inter-service connectivity
concerns.hazard: fragmented relationship between mental health and physical health services

concerns.quote: mental health provision for those with personality disorders must move towards an individual, therapeutic and trauma-informed approached
concerns.hazard: mental health provision for personality disorders

concerns.quote: communication with the families of patients with mental health difficulties is still not being effectively achieved
concerns.hazard: ineffective communication with families of patients with mental health difficulties

concerns.quote: more needs to be done to inform and assist families, particularly in cases of patients with neurodiversity
concerns.hazard: lack of information and assistance for families of patients with neurodiversity

reports.title: Ethel Robertson: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: the service is not routinely informed when one of their patients is admitted to or discharged from ED
concerns.hazard: lack of notification of patient admission or discharge

concerns.quote: OPMH will not know if one of their patients has had a physical health crisis which could precipitate a decline in their mental health
concerns.hazard: lack of awareness of physical health crises affecting mental health

concerns.quote: places an added pressure on those in primary care to have systems in place to alert the community teams when they receive discharge documentation from ED
concerns.hazard: burden on primary care to alert community teams

links.explanation: Both reports highlight a lack of communication and connectivity between mental health and physical health services, leading to missed information about patients' physical health crises.
links.earlier_quote: there is and remains a fragmented relationship between mental health and physical health services, with little inter-service connectivity.
links.later_quote: If the presentation at the hospital was for a mental health related issue, then the OPMH team is likely notified as there will be contact with the psychiatric liaison service in the hospital.
links.promise_quote: The creation of this new provider is progressing at pace (Project Fusion) with the new legal entity due to be in place by 1 April 2024.
